description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Regulations Made under the Section 41 to Read with the Section 31 of the Sport Law No. 25 of 1973
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the revocation of a previous regulation (Gazette No. 2356/43) and the dissolution of an interim committee for Sri Lanka Cricket. This constitutes a regulatory action made under the authority of the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. While a minister is named, the core content is about modifying the legal/regulatory framework governing sports, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization. Therefore, it fits best under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
